notes.title: BUGFIX PATCH
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Many QWERTY keyboard users have brought up a problem, being unable to switch the default AZERTY to QWERTY. 

A new patch has been deployed which now allows you to toggle between AZERTY & QWERTY keyboard layout.

To do so, go to the option menu and select the gameplay tab. The layout option is at the bottom of the list.

Please enjoy !
